basics.name: Rob O'Dwyer
basics.label: Full-stack Software Developer
basics.summary: I'm a full-stack software developer with experience in building a startup company's tech stack from the ground up. I'm particularly interested in optimizing software development with AI, machine learning, and infrastructure / DevOps.

work.name: Whalesync
work.summary: Used generative AI for a series of tools that automate the process of syncing and reviewing automated agent changes to content.

work.name: DevCycle
work.summary: Implemented SDKs in multiple languages, and profiled and optimized the Go SDK to meet low latency requirements.

work.name: Battlesnake
work.summary: Responsible for developing and scaling of Battlesnake game engine server and global proxy system.
highlights: Built out a global multi-datacenter proxy system to calculate player latency more equitably.

work.name: Workday
work.summary: Developed cloud services for processing video and interactive learning content
highlights: Led the migration of a production service along with customer data from the Workday datacenter to AWS.
Set up and trained a new developer team in Dublin, Ireland.

work.name: Pretio Interactive
work.summary: Part of the founding team and responsible for developing Pretio's core technology and growing the development team. Pretio Interactive was an ad-tech startup that combined machine learning and consumer preferences to serve personalized ads.
highlights: Recruited and trained development team while building the technology platform for Pretio's advertising network.
Designed and built a high throughput HTTP server in Go for integrating into real-time bidding networks, and successfully scaled it to operate at 10K requests/second.
Researched and implemented online machine learning techniques to optimize profitability.

work.name: Entrepreneurship@Alacrity
work.summary: The Entrepreneurship@Alacrity program provided an intense training environment to prepare graduates for entrepreneurship in the technology sector.
highlights: Worked with founding team of RewardsDen to develop the team and technology that later became Pretio Interactive.

work.name: Co-op Program Positions
work.summary: Completed multiple co-op placements during undergraduate studies at UBC.
highlights: PDFTron: Developed an HTML5 / Javascript application and SDK for document viewing and processing. Researched new HTML5 standards (e.g. Canvas, File APIs, Web Fonts) and browser compatibility issues.

Dolby Laboratories: Developed methods of testing and measuring the performance of an image processing algorithm in MATLAB. Applied color science to algorithm designs and implemented extensions to a real-time image processing pipeline in C.

BC Children's Hospital: Developed a Java plugin to interface between network and serial protocols of a medical monitoring device and the iAssist decision support software. Implemented a network protocol and DHCP server from device manufacturer specifications.

volunteer.summary: Helped update the platform for the BattleSnake programming competition, and acted as a mentor for junior developers at the event.
Mentored new developers at 3 workshops in 2015, 2016, 2017.
